proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d x₀ y₀ z₀ hN
  have hNpos : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm hN)
  have hS : 0 < √(a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNpos
  constructor
  · intro x y z h
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hS, ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
    apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
    have hk : a * x₀ + b * y₀ + c * z₀ + d = a * (x₀ - x) + b * (y₀ - y) + c * (z₀ - z) := by linarith
    rw [hk]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * (y₀ - y) - b * (x₀ - x)), sq_nonneg (a * (z₀ - z) - c * (x₀ - x)), sq_nonneg (b * (z₀ - z) - c * (y₀ - y))]
  · set k := a * x₀ + b * y₀ + c * z₀ + d with hk
    set N := a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 with hNdef
    refine ⟨x₀ - k * a / N, y₀ - k * b / N, z₀ - k * c / N, ?_, ?_⟩
    · field_simp
      rw [hk, hNdef]; ring
    · have : (x₀ - k * a / N - x₀) ^ 2 + (y₀ - k * b / N - y₀) ^ 2 + (z₀ - k * c / N - z₀) ^ 2 = k ^ 2 / N := by
        field_simp
        rw [hNdef]; ring
      rw [this, Real.sqrt_div (sq_nonneg k), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
